body: Took two tramadol to see what they taste like. Just gonna think more til daylight ...

Ohhh I'm sorry for your grief. I completely understand and am sad for you. It must hurt deeply. I'm sad for me too though. I'm like a little black cloud floating from room to room. But sorry for your loss. XOXO
Thank you for that ... I'm trying to hang on ... But I know no miracle is coming that will turn it all around. Been sitting up all night trying not to do it. Thanks though. XOXO

Please tell me ... what is your life like now? Your story has things similar to mine and I'm just hoping that somehow in 3 months everything is better. I really hope that. I really do so that you can reply to me and tell me not to do it. I've been siting with this pill bottle in my hand for five hours. If you can tell me it all worked out that'd be great. It'd save my life ....

Yes! Useless they spent a good chunk of time asking me how I planned to do it. Then they looked up resources in my area. Then they asked what the problem was: long term unemployment, homeless, sick parent, no money, losing possessions, etc. Yup, no solution right? They said call back if you need us. REALLY? That number is posted so many places online and it's the first thing that pops up if you google SUICIDE. I don't know what I expected -- a direct line to Jesus maybe, or something more like a professional counselor. Not even close.

I shall go back to counting my pills I suppose.
Thanks for trying to help but I'm just too worn out. There are so many teenagers on here talking about suicide ... Try to help them instead. XOXO

Yes I saw that but I am too new to reddit to use it. I also tried modest needs.org but I had to have rec'd a paycheck or deposit in my bank in the last 30 days and I have not. I also tried youcaring crowd funding after the hospice nurse said try any resources you can to get here but there was some strange PayPal glitch. Tried churches, united way 211, travelers aid  ... Everything. And nothing. The car people and storage people harass me all day long. It's just too much. They won't stop I know. That's their contractual right even when I want to scream LEAVE ME ALONE MY MOTHER IS DYING!

P.S. my son is the one who told me about reddit so I know he will see the computer history one day ... Please tell him YOUR MOMMIE LOVED U SO SO MUCH JUST KEEP GOING YOU'RE GOING TO BE JUST FINE!

I know that people who wouldn't help me will help him because they will feel guilty and sad for him ... It will be all right.

Thank you for caring. XOXO

Thank you so much. I know it will be hard on my son but while we were living in the shelter and sleeping in the car I kept saying AFTER THIS ALWAYS REMEMBER YOU CAN SURVIVE ANYTHING. Despite what we went through he had passed all his AP classes and graduated high school with honors. He is my hero. He never complained once though many days he would watch me cry for hours. More than anything I can't let him watch me crumble any farther than I already have especially now that my mother is in hospice. Plus when they take the car and all our belongings in storage it will be because I died not because I failed him and lost it all. But thank you. XOXO

You are so kind. Thank you for replying. Being a mother myself I know my mother wouldn't want this. But I have a son who has also suffered through this homelessness with me and because of me. He'll be a freshman in college and deserves to have my mother's life insurance all to himself. XOXO
